collīneō (conl-), collīneāre

verb, first conjugation

aim straight, hit the mark

Rare; Cicero.

Examples

  • Collīneāvī!

    Bullseye!composed

  • quis est enim, quī tōtum diem jaculāns nōn aliquandō conlīniet?

    who throws all day without sometimes hitting the mark?Cic. Div. 2.121, the edition’s form

See also spot on, miss, almost, bravo.
